_readme: Registry for xcmd (put this file in the root of the xmod GitHub repository). Every package here overrides what xcmd detects from the file names. Fields: name, title, version, kind (core|extension|mod|plugin), description, tags, file (path in the repo) or url, requires, metamod (dll base names), namespace (extension namespace), plugins (lines for configs/plugins-<name>.ini when the zip has none), order.
